description: List events on a Google Calendar calendar, optionally within a time range.

calendar_id.description: The ID of the calendar to list events from. Defaults to "primary" if omitted.

max_results.description: The maximum number of events to return.

query.description: Free-text search query to filter events by.

time_max.description: The end of the time range to list events in, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

time_min.description: The start of the time range to list events in, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

name: list_events
